name: vendor.openwop-app.workflows.forms-intake
description: Self-serve intake portal (ADR 0246/0247, STRAT-PORTAL). Bridges the forms feature to priority-matrix idea intake WITHOUT either feature importing the other: a public/authed form submission emits host.forms.submission.created (ADR 0208), this chain re-reads the submission under authz via ctx.features.forms.getSubmission, and — when the form's owner has configured an intake binding — files it as an idea on the bound priority-matrix list through the existing submit-idea verb, which also stamps the idea's intake overlay with sourceChannel='form' + the sourceSubmissionId for provenance (ADR 0247 OQ-5). A form with no binding cleanly no-ops (the conditional edge). The anonymous submitter never chooses the list (owner-configured binding); the target list's org-ownership is enforced at the submit-idea write boundary (expectedOrgId). Bind it per tenant to host.forms.submission.created via the ADR 0208 event→workflow bindings.
author: openwop-app

chains.label: Forms: Route Submission to Intake
chains.description: On host.forms.submission.created, re-read the submission under authz and — if the form has an intake binding — file it as a priority-matrix idea (title/notes from the bound fields, list from the owner-configured binding), stamping form provenance (sourceChannel='form' + submissionId) on the idea. No binding ⇒ no-op. If the owner-bound list was deleted after binding, submit-idea 404s but the run still COMPLETES cleanly via the `done` terminal's `all_complete` edge (RFC 0125 fan-in / error-routing) — the submission is always captured, so a stale binding degrades gracefully instead of failing the run (ADR 0247 OQ-2). 1.2.0 (ADR 0584): the `file → done` edge is PORT-QUALIFIED (WF-FORM-1) so the declared output is reachable and a degraded run is distinguishable from a filed one, and a third branch off `get` turns 'there is no submission to route' into a TYPED failure instead of a green empty run (WF-FORM-2). 1.3.0 (ADR 0584 §Correction, WF-FORM-5): the three branches off `get` are MUTUALLY EXCLUSIVE. They were `equals willFile yes` / `notEquals willFile yes` / `falsy found`, and on a miss the middle two were BOTH true, so `skip` and `refuse` fired together — the test passed only because `stop-and-error` terminates the run, i.e. it was pinned to a resolution rule rather than to the routing. They now switch on one three-valued `route` output ('file' | 'skip' | 'refuse'), so a future change to terminal resolution cannot silently re-green the manual run. Also (FORM-QUAR-1) a QUARANTINED submission answers `willFile:'no'` → `route:'skip'`: a held row is stored for a human to review and is never filed as intake.

nodes.name: No submission to route — fail honestly (WF-FORM-2)

config.message: There is no submission to route. This chain is EVENT-IGNITED: it reads the ids that host.forms.submission.created carries, so a manual run from the workflow picker has no payload and nothing to fetch. Bind it to that event on the Event Bindings page instead.

value.description: The filed idea's card id. WF-FORM-1: this used to be declared as `cardId` and was STRUCTURALLY UNREACHABLE — `outputRole:'primary'` lands on the `done` noop, which returns only `{value: ctx.inputs.value}`, and the bare `file → done` edge delivered `{cardId,title,status}` (no key named `value`). So every run — filed, degraded, skipped — reported `{value: undefined}`, and the ADR 0247 OQ-2 graceful degrade was indistinguishable from a success at the run boundary. Port-qualifying BOTH ends makes the declared output reachable AND the two paths distinguishable in one change. Absent when the form has no intake binding, or when the owner-bound list was deleted (the degrade path).
